question.question: Throughput only: on one Kaggle T4x2 kernel, how much faster does the same K1 Muon 100K step run with device_resident_train on (muon_on, GPU 1) than off (muon_off, GPU 0)? Infrastructure measurement, not scientific evidence.
question.deficiency: Training is CPU launch-bound; host-side data path is a candidate cost.
question.positive_decision: Report per-run wall and epoch loss only; no scientific claim.

profile.hardware: Tesla T4x2 FP32/noTF32, one newly trained model per device, identical recipe on both arms
profile.cheapest_falsifier: Two-epoch wall time of muon_on versus muon_off measured concurrently on the same kernel.

authority.authority: User asked on 2026-11-10 to measure the device-resident input speedup with both arms on the two T4 devices of one kernel, and authorized Opus decisions while away.
authority.scope: One K1 Muon 100K job with two identical arms paused after step 1562 (two epochs), seed 42; muon_on has device-resident inputs, muon_off does not. Throughput measurement only; no acceptance as science, no protected roles, no successors.
